title: Hardship and Protective Holds — Cure Allowance by Kind of Documentation
content:
**Schedule note.** The days allowed to cure on a cure notice under Hardship and Protective Holds carry a cure form allowance that depends on the kind of documentation the notice asks for. The notice asks for the kind of documentation carried by the latest submission received on the request. The allowance is added once to the days allowed to cure:

| Kind of documentation the notice asks for | Cure form allowance |
|---|---|
| A physician's medical or disability certification | 7 calendar days (physician form allowance) |
| Household income records (income loss evidence) | 3 calendar days (statement allowance) |
| Any other kind — disaster-area residence proof, a financial assistance application, active-duty status proof or a self-attested statement | None |

**Reading the note.**

- The kind is taken from the latest submission received on the request, not from an earlier one. If an earlier submission carried income records and the latest carries a physician's certification, the notice asks for the certification and 7 days are added.
- Only the two kinds named above add days.

**Example (hypothetical).** The latest submission on a request carries household income records: 3 calendar days are added to the days allowed to cure.
